system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Concordia agents are component networks (memories, long-term objectives, perception of self/others etc.) whose state are updated with experience and are used as social context for LLMs to infer agent plans
system_prompt_style.note: Component network feeds the act component's call-to-action prompt; persona/context also templated from YAML field_map.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: When agents open Mastodon, they read their feed and choose from a set of actions ('post', 'follow', etc.).
env_context_strategy.note: Social-simulation environment, not a repository; closest value is none beyond the observation/timeline text injected by the game master.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: `window` (default, last-N), `retrieval` (a recent-window floor plus the most relevant older memories), or `summarizing` (rolling summaries + retrieved older memories + a recent window)
context_compaction.note: Default memory policy is `window` (last-N) = truncate_oldest; `summarizing` and `retrieval` reachable via sim.memory.

observation_format.evidence_quote: multi-modal capabilities that enable our agents to interact using both text and images—just as humans do on social media
observation_format.note: Images are converted to text impressions; observations reach agents as text (`observe(observation: str)`).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Return only a valid JSON object. Do not wrap it in Markdown.
tool_call_format.note: GM has a `tool_calling` resolve mode as well as `parsed_action`; `_call_model()` handles tool calls and structured outputs.

tool_count.note: Action catalog is backend/scenario-dependent (enabled_actions/excluded_actions); no fixed default tool count in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: When agents open Mastodon, they read their feed and choose from a set of actions ('post', 'follow', etc.).
edit_primitive.note: Social platform actions only; no file-editing primitive.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: request.surface.schemas() lists the actions this agent may call (already filtered to the backend catalog + the agent's flow).
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas come from backend action catalogs declared in code/YAML; generation mechanism not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Interoperability for Concordia-designed agents is available through an optional bridge extra.
protocol_standardization.note: Concordia bridge is a framework interop layer, not a published agent protocol; no MCP/A2A evidence found.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: In each episode loop, agents make observations, update their internal state, and propose subsequent actions to a controller (the “gamemaster”), which evaluates actions and updates the environment state
loop_primitives.note: Default loop strategy is fixed_steps; harness agents run their own model→tool loop inside one turn.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: We store the agentic output and the within-agent processing (prompt-response pairs, and latent actions) for post-simulation analysis.
planning_granularity.note: Agent plans are inferred in prompts (component network), no stored structured plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A ‘Gamemaster’ agent abstraction orchestrates simulation control by evaluating attempted actions, handling events, and distributing their effects.
multi_agent_topology.note: Many peer agents on a shared platform, mediated by a game master; closest value peer (orchestrator is a GM, not a delegating agent).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: agents make observations, update their internal state, and propose subsequent actions to a controller (the “gamemaster”), which evaluates actions and updates the environment state
delegation_mechanism.note: No agent-to-agent delegation; interaction is via the shared platform/game master, coded as the closest value.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Everything else is inherited: probes, interventions, checkpoints, and interactive control all keep their default behaviour.
human_in_loop.note: 'interactive control' and interventions exist in the loop; gating point not specified.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A custom policy is a `MemoryPolicy` subclass (`record` / `render` / `all_memories` / `get_state` / `set_state`) referenced via `sim.memory.class_path`
short_term_state.note: Agents keep memory-policy state plus checkpointable component state, beyond a message list.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Load memories from string, file path, or list
long_term_memory.note: Memories are seeded from files/datasets at step 0 (sim.initialization.agents); no cross-run memory store shown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We add a survey system deployed longitudinally on the agent population to passively probe their in-context beliefs.
self_verification.note: Probes/evaluators are measurement of agents rather than correctness verification of work products.

retry_policy.note: This is model-call retry on parse/API failure, not task-level retry; no task-level retry found.

rollback.note: Checkpoint save/restore of runtime state serves as rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
Override scale or model settings with Hydra dot notation:

```sh
uv run silisocs num_agents=10 num_steps=5 sim.llm.name=gpt-4o
```
termination_condition.note: FixedStepsLoopStrategy consumes max_steps; harness turns additionally bounded by max_iterations.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
voter:
    count: 100
    model: gpt-4o-mini      # Cheaper model for background agents
cost_controls.note: Per-class/per-agent model assignment for cost; token usage and pricing are reported but not capped.

timeouts.note: Per-model-call timeout; no run-level timeout found.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
The default package is intentionally lean and supports local simulations without
Studio, Mastodon, HuggingFace, or analysis dependencies
execution_isolation.note: Default runs locally in-process via `uv run silisocs`; served Mastodon backend is remote and opt-in.

filesystem_access.note: Agents act on platform backends, not a filesystem; harness writes to the outputs directory.

network_policy.note: No network restriction configuration present; LLM API and Mastodon server calls go out unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
the backend's
  `enabled_actions`/`excluded_actions` catalog restriction, actor-argument injection
permission_model.note: Action catalog allow/exclude lists plus per-flow flow_action_filters.

tracing.note: On by default; also runtime telemetry (SimMetricsCollector).

replayability.evidence_quote:
It expands hypotheses, conditions, scenarios, and
seeds into reproducible simulation runs
replayability.note: Seeded, checkpoint-resumable runs with a resolved config snapshot; no bit-for-bit claim.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
then executes the configured evaluators
and writes organized artifacts under the study's `generated/` directory.
eval_hooks.note: silisocs.evaluations package plus the study runner's evaluators.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
the backend's
  `enabled_actions`/`excluded_actions` catalog restriction, actor-argument injection
guardrails.note: Game master evaluates and may reject attempted actions; no input/output filters found.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A configurable, extensible framework for multi-agent social simulation and experimentation.

open_source.note: Public repo with CI and PyPI package; LICENSE file not in the supplied evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
Common providers ship as named
   presets — `anthropic`, `gemini`, `openrouter`, `groq`, `together`,
   `deepseek`, `mistral`, `fireworks`, `xai`, `ollama`.
